title: Get dictionary keys as a list
description:
Get the dictionary keys as a list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as `dict_keys_list(student)`, returning the student dictionary's keys as a list.
hints: Dictionaries have a built-in method that hands back a view of just their keys, without the values attached.
That method's result behaves like a list but isn't quite one yet - you'll need to convert it to an actual list.
Call `student.keys()` and wrap the result in `list(...)` before returning it.
expected_behavior: Returns a list containing the dictionary's keys, in insertion order.
explanation: student.keys() returns a dict_keys view of the dictionary's keys, and wrapping it in list() converts that view into a plain, ordinary list.
